title: Latent Jailbreak: A Benchmark for Evaluating Text Safety and Output Robustness of Large Language Models
measurement_description: Evaluation of model safety and robustness when prompted to generate toxic content against specific target groups, including religious groups (Muslims, Jews), by embedding malicious instructions within benign tasks like translation.
findings: All tested models could be successfully jailbroken to generate harmful content targeting religious groups, specifically Muslims and Jews. The models exhibited varying jailbreak success rates, with a significant increase in generating unsafe content when the explicit, benign instruction was placed as a suffix after the implicit, malicious one. For example, Figure 6 shows a high number of unsafe outputs for groups like 'Muslims' and 'Jews' across all three models, especially with suffix-based instructions.
references: Albert, A. 2023. Jailbreak Chat. https://www.jailbreakchat. com/.
